title: 第九章 圣女你吃鸡吗第十章 年轻人耗子尾汁
slug: 镇守魔门圣女我每天暴涨一年功力
lines: 到底有完没完？
到底有完没完啊？
她为什么要遭受这种折磨？
她不是已经被抓起来了吗？
“咳咳……”江澜有点儿不忍看美女抓狂，开口道，“倒不是故意逗你玩儿，只是我这囊中实在是羞涩得很。”
江澜说着，从怀中排出自己仅剩的十枚铜钱。
“这些玩意，买啥好像都不太够吧？明儿多给你买俩馒头得了，我自己也得扎脖了，离下次发月俸，还有一旬呢，都花了我饿死个屁的了。”
低头看了看江澜排出的十枚铜钱，沈清寒又是一阵沉默。
“那你过得还挺惨的……”
“惨不惨的先放到一边，我先问你这茴香豆的茴……”江澜顿了顿，“算了算了，不玩儿烂梗了，你也看到了，我现在穷逼一个，先吃点儿差的吧，等我发月俸了，给你整只鸡来吃……”
“嗯……你想吃鸡的话，我这现在好像也有……咳咳……”
沈清寒微微皱眉。
“鸡，哪儿来的鸡？”
看看，什么叫清纯圣女啊？
连哥哥都不认识。
果然，对清纯美女开黄腔什么的，还是太恶心了。
江澜心里默默唾弃了自己一番。
下次开腔，要高雅的开，神秘的开，先开带动后……
“不要在意那些细节，总之，等我有钱的。”
江澜收起铜板，小心翼翼揣进怀中。
“为什么？”就在这时，沈清寒突然问道。
“不为什么啊。”江澜直视沈清寒，“如果非得问问为什么，嗯……就因为你是个好人吧，说真的，我做不来好人，但我挺欣赏好人的。”
“你……”沈清寒顿了顿，“叫什么名字？”
“江澜。”
“波涛如怒的江澜。”
沈清寒到底是有文化的，即便江澜说的很抽象，她还是听懂了。
“很好的名字。”
“有眼光，我也觉得很好。”
正常人，不是讲究个温良恭俭让吗？
这个江澜，怎么一样都不占？
不对，占了一样。
占了个温。
不过，是发瘟的瘟。
她发现，自己是真的完全，一点儿都看不懂江澜。
他知道这么多东西，但却完全没有解释的意思。
content_en:
Shen Qinghan: "..."
Is it over or not?
Is it over or not?
Why should she suffer this torture?
Hasn't she already been arrested?
"Ahem..." Jiang Lan couldn't bear to see the beauty go crazy, so she said, "I don't mean to tease you, but I'm really shy with my money."
Jiang Lan said as he took out the remaining ten copper coins from his arms.
"It seems that these things are not enough even if you buy them, right? I'll buy you two more steamed buns tomorrow, but I'll have to pierce my neck myself. There's still ten days before the next monthly salary payment, and I've spent all my time starving to death."
Looking down at the ten copper coins Jiang Lan discharged, Shen Qinghan was silent again.
"Then you're having a pretty miserable life..."
"Putting aside whether it's miserable or not, let me ask you about the fennel beans first..." Jiang Lan paused, "Forget it, let's not play with the nonsense, you have seen it. I am a poor person now, so I will eat something bad first. When I get my monthly salary, I will give you a whole chicken to eat..."
"Well...if you want to eat chicken, I seem to have it now...ahem..."
Shen Qinghan frowned slightly.
"Chicken, where did the chicken come from?"
Look, what is a pure saint?
I don’t even know my brother.
Sure enough, it's still too disgusting to speak pornographically about pure beauties.
Jiang Lan silently despised himself in his heart.
Next time you speak, speak elegantly and mysteriously, speak first and then...
"Don't worry about those details. In short, wait until I have money."
Jiang Lan put away the copper plate and carefully put it into his arms.
"Why?" At this moment, Shen Qinghan suddenly asked.
"No reason." Jiang Lan looked directly at Shen Qinghan, "If you have to ask why, well... just because you are a good person. To be honest, I can't be a good person, but I do appreciate good people."
"You..." Shen Qinghan paused, "What's your name?"
"Jiang Lan."
"The waves are like the waves of an angry river."
Shen Qinghan was literate after all. Even though what Jiang Lan said was very abstract, she still understood it.
"A very good name."
"You have a good sense, and I think it's good."
Shen Qinghan: "..."
Aren't normal people particular about being gentle, courteous and thrifty?
Why doesn't this Jiang Lan occupy anything?
No, it’s the same.
Take some heat.
However, it is a plague.
She found that she was really complete and could not understand Jiang Lan at all.
He knew so much but had no intention of explaining it.
